summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated August 13, 2026 responding to short-seller Viceroy Research Group's report. The release refutes alleged misinformation about the Nussir copper-silver-gold project in Norway, states all permits are in good standing, and cites support from Norwegian officials and institutional investors. The filing is defensive commentary addressing public criticism; no transaction, tender, or corporate action is announced. This is a routine current report on Form 6-K, not a special situation. No deal terms, pricing, or strategic actions are provided. What to watch: any subsequent regulatory or operational developments regarding Norwegian permits.
